svg.text: Phase 3 — the model, the clip, the lanes and the evidence
Task groups 3.3 to 3.7. Three subtasks cannot close here: they read a log that only a deployed Room produces.
the clip and its written source
the clip baked into the image
detector and model in the image
the lane that runs the detector
its lane, so it is repeatable
the detection log and its numbers
Waiting on a deployed Room — no code left to write
The recorded evidence for this phase came off the development machine, not off the lane the
plan names as its venue — and on that machine the detection rate measured 2.65 per second
against a floor of 5. The machine emulates a different processor, so the figure understates a
real runner; the number that decides the criterion is the one taken on the deployed node.
not started; nothing left to write
